rows.note: For food, 熟 is the all-purpose adjective for being cooked; the fact that it was boiled must come from context.
Use 滾 for a liquid that has reached boiling point, rather than 熟 for food that is cooked.
Use 火滾 for someone who is angrily worked up, with a stronger flavour than the neutral word for angry.

example.english: I was boiled with anger after they cheated me.
